capabilities: Record LLM calls to rotating JSONL trace files
Rate and tag recordings in a review view
Skip calls that used notes from excluded folders
Pause recording for the current session
disambiguation: Not an LLM client; it only records calls other plugins already sent and received and never contacts a model or endpoint.
extras: Infrastructure for plugin authors, not a standalone feature; it records nothing unless a sibling plugin calls its API. README stresses that masking is pattern-only and not a general anonymizer, so traces are as confidential as the notes and prompts that produced them. Full API contract, guides, and troubleshooting live in separate files (AGENTS.md, docs).
motivation: To let the good answers from local LLM calls be rated and turned into evaluation or fine-tuning material.
problem: Obsidian plugins that call local LLMs keep no record of how well those calls go, so good answers can't be rated or reused.

requires.name: A plugin that calls the LLM Lab API (first consumer: vault-rag)

summary: Recorder that logs local LLM calls made by other Obsidian plugins into rotating JSONL trace files stored inside the vault.
